test_item:
In order to know the notifications sequence received by the target functions, DebugAuth includes the sequence ID into the notification message.
(sequence ID is included, logged and incremented when a status message is sent)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. DebugAuth is running on the DUT
proc:
1. Clear the log buffer before the status message is sent
$ adb logcat -c
2. Read the stored sequence ID before the status message is sent
$ adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/seqId
3. <DUT-side trigger for SAM AuthData status change provided by RD (X-g)>
$ <command provided by RD (X-g)>
4. Confirm the dauth log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s dauth
5. Read the stored sequence ID after the status message is sent
$ adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/seqId
er:
1. The log buffer is cleared
2. The adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/seqId output shows the current sequence ID
3. <observable outcome provided by RD (X-g)>
4. The adb logcat -s dauth output contains the sent message with the sequence ID
5. The adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/seqId output shows the incremented sequence ID
